newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semicon Jan sales down 23.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semicon Jan sales down 23.9 pct.

text.p: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp (TSMC), Taiwan's largest semiconductor maker, said on Thursday its January sales revenue fell 23.9 percent to T$2.532 billion from T$3.329 billion in January 1996.
A company statement attributed the decline to a fall in the average selling price.
"TSMC's averge selling price fell around 25 percent from the corresponding period of last year," the statement said.
The company has said that its 1996 net profit rose 28.6 percent to T$19.401 billion, while sales revenue advanced 37 percent to a record T$39.4 billion.
